item.title: Critique my logo please!
item.description:
Hi!

I’ve designed a couple logos for an accelerator called “WE”. For some reason I’ve been struggling with how short the term “WE” is.

The first logo is based on an isometric grid. I don’t know how legible it may be.
The second one is much simpler.

What do you think? Which one should I go with? What should I change?

Thanks in advance.

item.title: (x) MetaPhile: We need a way to link to specific comments
item.description: Every comment needs a permalink. A fragment identifier (starting with a letter, followed by letters, numbers, dashes, or periods) is sufficient if such is exposed to us without having to view source. (It doesn’t have to be like Twitter, where every Twit gets its own Web page.)
